claims.statement: Czyste Powietrze currently requires qualifying heat pumps to be on List ZUM on the invoice date.
The programme ties eligibility to laboratory or recognised quality evidence, with accredited laboratory testing retained for popular air-to-water pumps.
Demand hypothesis: overseas OEMs will pay a local intermediary to reduce rejected or stale model submissions and preserve subsidised-channel access.

contrary_evidence: Suppliers can submit directly and may treat the process as an occasional consulting task rather than recurring software.
Recognised quality marks simplify entry for several pump categories, reducing evidence complexity.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: two laboratory or master-distributor channels can introduce many non-Polish OEMs without founder-led mass outreach
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 120 suppliers averaging 45000 PLN annual revenue could support roughly 5.4m PLN ARR; durable profitability and adjacent subsidy-list expansion could make founder equity exceed 5m PLN in 4-6 years
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours weekly for a narrow pilot; specialist review purchased per file
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 70-85% software-led gross margin after document review is standardised
economics.payback: Hypothesis: setup capital recovered in 6-10 months with six onboarding projects and ten monitored families
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 10000-25000 PLN onboarding per model family plus 1500-4000 PLN monthly monitoring
economics.retention_or_repeat: New SKUs, report revisions, EPREL checks, programme changes and annual catalogue refreshes

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned corpus of report-to-SKU mappings, validation failures and change histories improves preflight checks and raises switching costs
fingerprint.customer: Heat-pump manufacturers, importers and distributors seeking subsidised Polish sales
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: White-label referral inside accredited laboratory and HVAC-distributor workflows
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed evidence workspace plus fixed-fee onboarding and recurring per-model monitoring subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Supplier pays at initial evidence-pack submission, each new model-family submission and ongoing status monitoring
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A SKU must be on List ZUM when invoiced to qualify under Czyste Powietrze, while evidence and status can change

founder_fit: Direct leverage from the family renewable-installation channel
Document parsing and status monitoring suit data-science and AI automation skills
Can begin part-time without public-facing content
risks: Programme or ZUM rules may change abruptly.
Incorrect preflight advice could delay market access, so contractual scope and expert sign-off are essential.
Laboratories or large distributors could build the workflow themselves.

structure.commercial_archetype: Regulatory evidence operations SaaS with managed-service wedge
structure.control_point: The model-specific evidence pack released before ZUM submission and subsidised-channel listing
structure.critical_dependency: Continued ZUM gate relevance plus access to supplier-owned reports and laboratory partners

thesis: A document-control service sold through accredited laboratories and Polish HVAC distributors could turn test reports, EPREL records, labels and List ZUM submissions into a release gate for each heat-pump SKU. It would prepare and monitor evidence, not perform tests or promise approval. Demand and economics are hypotheses to validate.
title: ZUM Evidence Gate for Heat-Pump Suppliers
uncertainties: Number of suppliers with enough Polish revenue to pay recurring fees
Availability of machine-readable status data or permitted automation
Actual submission rejection and update frequency
